description: List open times for a free 30-minute phone consultation with a Seaworthy Insurance disability insurance advisor over the next 14 days (the advisor calls the user). Times are shown in the time zone you pass; each slot carries the UTC start_time to pass to book_consultation. Read-only: nothing is booked. Unauthenticated.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, 1 to 14. Default 14.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. "America/New_York". Defaults to America/Los_Angeles; ask the user if you do not know it.

name: get_consultation_availability
